name: demo-app-portfolio
description: Application de démonstration doqa.io : API Express + PostgreSQL et front React, avec sa stratégie de test

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: npm run db:up && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix server start" "npm --prefix client start"
scripts.start: npm run db:up && npm run build && cross-env CLIENT_BUILD_DIR=../client/build npm --prefix server start
scripts.test:e2e:full: npm run db:up && npm run build && playwright test
